caption: The drawing depicts a formal dress with short sleeves and a fitted bodice, rendered primarily in pale peach with detailing in white and gray pencil. The main view shows the dress from the front, emphasizing a full-length skirt decorated with symmetrical white floral embroidery along the front seams and around the hem. There is a long, translucent veil or sash with intricate floral lace detail draped over one shoulder and extending down along the side of the dress. A narrow darker band outlines the waist. The background is plain and light beige, matching the dress’s soft hues. In the top right corner of the image, there is a smaller, less detailed sketch of the same dress from the back, including the sash draped over the shoulder and some minimal seam lines, without color or ornate detailing.
title: Dress
